contract: raw Journey input must be validated before compatibility normalization can erase semantic identity
documented_ambiguities: Only canonical movement keys are supported; natural-language synonyms belong to upstream parser/director adapters.
Missing/null direction and numeric/string 1 or -1 are compatibility; other direction coercions are incidental and must be rejected at raw authority.
Zero revolutions is not promoted as compatibility: it fails the current compile/parse verification contract; negative, non-finite and non-numeric revolutions are invalid.
Missing/null Journey version migrates to v1; an explicit value other than numeric 1 is not an alias.
Dynamic reclassification of already-accepted valid movements to hover remains legitimate downstream semantic behavior.
